proposal.reason: Primary change is in network: NET/CollNet backend selection and plugin lifetime move to per-communicator state, and proxy progress/shutdown/connect behavior is reworked. communicator is additionally required because comm init/free/split now own netName/config copying, backend compatibility for shared resources, and per-comm backend flags. graph-search is additionally required because PXN-disable and graph comparison decisions now depend on communicator-specific NET/EIC state. device-topology is additionally required because topology XML/system construction and NIC/EIC width handling now use per-comm backend/collnet properties and a new per-topology useEic field.
